title: sawers-rellan-labs/zealgt - params.input schema for --entry read_trimming / read_alignment
description: Paired FASTQs per sample: demultiplexed reads (read_trimming) or trimmed reads (read_alignment). Every sample must be in params.samples (meta/samples.csv), which supplies library and read-group fields. crop_r1 / crop_r2 are required: the non-genomic 5' bases the FASTQs still carry (e.g. Nirwan's filtered_S batch-1 reads: 12 on R1, 0 on R2); only 0 is supported so far, so reads that still carry primer bases are refused instead of aligned.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided (letters, digits, _ . - only)

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

crop_r1.errorMessage: crop_r1: bases still to remove from the 5' end of read 1 (primer / randomer / skip bases left by the demultiplexer); 0 if none

crop_r2.errorMessage: crop_r2: bases still to remove from the 5' end of read 2 (primer / randomer / skip bases left by the demultiplexer); 0 if none
